goal: Converge Vulkan and D3D12 on one backend-executor architecture. Finish Vulkan cleanup in M2. Lift only proven backend-agnostic pieces to RHI.

document_contract.update_rule: Replans must update this file and the active checkpoint file in the same change.

architecture_rules.rule: RHIExecutor owns one backend executor instance. ERHIType branching is construction-only.
Every backend executor implements one lifecycle: Enqueue, Flush, Sync, ShutDown.
Flush semantics are single-owner semantics. RHITranslate and SubmitGPU are progression depths, not mixed wait policies.
Sync semantics are single-owner semantics. Sync may depend on a required flush depth, but must not duplicate backend-side progression policy.
The Vulkan stage chain is fixed: ingress -> preprocess -> parallel translate -> submission runtime -> interrupt runtime.
Only backend-agnostic admission, batch metadata, flush-depth semantics, and translate scheduling contracts may move to RHI.
Backend-specific preprocess, native translation, submit packet encoding, and completion polling stay backend-owned.
D3D12 must implement the same public executor contract after Vulkan cleanup. No D3D12-only execution surface is allowed.

stages.title: Freeze executor contract
exit_gate: The backend executor contract is fixed.
The Vulkan stage chain is fixed.
The RHI reuse boundary is fixed.
The D3D12 parity target is fixed.

stages.title: Finish Vulkan cleanup
exit_gate: Vulkan no longer keeps duplicated Flush or Sync progression ownership.
RHI admission no longer performs present-ordering fallback waits.
Vulkan cleanup is closed inside M2, not deferred to M3.

stages.title: Lift proven RHI reuse
exit_gate: Shared executor contracts live in RHI.
Shared translate scheduling contracts no longer depend on Vulkan-only naming.
Vulkan keeps no shadow private path for lifted behavior.

stages.title: Align D3D12 to the shared executor
exit_gate: D3D12 implements the same executor contract as Vulkan.
D3D12 stage ownership matches the shared executor design.
RHIExecutor no longer carries empty lifecycle branches for D3D12.

validation: Keep M1 completed unless the executor contract changes.
Run testscripts/test_rhi_translate.ps1 on every executor or progression landing.
Run testscripts/test_all.ps1 after each milestone-sized landing.
Do not add a new primary validation script.
